title: Standardize authz 403 responses w/ reason codes + structured decision logging
author: Kaitlyn Nguyen
release_notes: Internal: Control plane now returns consistent 403 payloads for authz denials with stable reason codes; authz decision logs include allow/deny + reason + permission identifiers for audit/debugging.
description:
Context: As part of RBAC v2 rollout (ENG-5384/5385/5387) we need consistent, machine-readable authorization denial responses and structured logs that let us debug customer 403s, measure shadow-deny deltas, and provide audit evidence. Prior behavior varied by service/middleware: some endpoints returned plain "forbidden", others returned ad-hoc JSON, and logs didn’t reliably include which permission check failed or whether a deny was due to missing role assignment vs policy mismatch vs scope mismatch.

This PR introduces: (1) a standardized 403 response envelope for authz denials across the control plane HTTP stack, including stable reason codes; (2) structured logging fields emitted for every authz decision (allow/deny) at the middleware boundary; (3) unit + integration coverage to ensure we don’t regress as we integrate more endpoints.

What changed (high level): Added an AuthzError type with a small fixed set of reason codes. Updated the authz middleware to map denial outcomes to the standard 403 response payload. Added structured log fields (authz.decision, authz.reason, authz.permission, authz.resource, authz.scope, authz.policy_version, org_id, project_id, actor_id) for both allow and deny decisions (sampling applied for allow logs; deny logs always emitted). Added helpers so callers can attach optional debug context without leaking sensitive policy details.

403 response contract (new): HTTP 403 always returns JSON with {"error": {"type": "authorization_denied", "reason": <stable_code>, "message": <safe_message>, "request_id": <id>}}. Stable reason codes introduced in this PR: MISSING_AUTHENTICATION (used only when auth middleware mistakenly routes unauthenticated requests into authz layer; should be rare), INSUFFICIENT_ROLE, PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED, SCOPE_MISMATCH, POLICY_NOT_LOADED, POLICY_EVALUATION_ERROR, SUPPORT_IMPERSONATION_DISABLED. Note: We intentionally do not include full policy expressions or role names in the response to avoid information leakage; the request_id + structured logs are used for internal debugging.

Structured logging contract (new fields): All authz checks emit an "authz" field group. Denies: always log at warn with decision=deny and include reason + permission identifiers. Allows: log at debug (or info when shadow-eval enabled) with sampling to avoid log volume regressions. We also attach these fields to the request span for tracing correlation.

Illustrative snippet (middleware mapping): if decision.Deny { return ctx.JSON(403, NewAuthzDeniedResponse(decision.ReasonCode, requestID)) } and logger.Warn("authz denied", FieldsFromDecision(decision)...) .

Files/areas touched: control-plane auth middleware, shared error helpers, request logging utilities, integration tests for key endpoints that are currently being migrated (org settings + API keys).

Follow-ups: (a) wire these reason codes into Console UI copy (DES-241) so we can show actionable errors; (b) add exporter mappings for authz.reason to SIEM schemas (ENG-5387); (c) unify gateway-side authz denial format once gateway is fully on new middleware (Amara has a WIP).

Testing: unit tests for reason mapping and log field generation; integration tests asserting response payload shape and stable reason codes for representative denial scenarios; ran control-plane test suite + lint.

Risk: Low-medium. Response payload changes apply only to 403 cases (previously inconsistent). We validated existing clients (console backend, internal tooling) only check status code, not body, but we still kept message field human-readable and did not remove request_id headers. Log volume impact mitigated by sampling allow logs and only always-logging denies.

Docs: Internal API standard update will follow in confluence (authz-check-standard) once this merges; this PR adds code-level documentation in the authz package and godoc for reason codes.

Checklist: Added tests for new reason codes, verified no PII leaks in response payload, ensured request_id included, added metrics tags for deny reason codes (authz_denied_total{reason=...}).
commits: authz: introduce AuthzError + stable reason codes
control-plane: standardize 403 JSON response for authz denies
logging: add structured authz decision fields + span attributes
tests: add integration coverage for denial payloads + reason mapping
metrics: authz_denied_total reason label + evaluation error counters
conversation:
Marcus Lin (review): Reason code set looks good. Please confirm we’re not returning role names/permission strings in the client-visible payload. Also ensure POLICY_EVALUATION_ERROR is distinguishable from POLICY_NOT_LOADED in logs/metrics for audit/debug.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (author): Confirmed: response payload includes only reason code + safe message + request_id. Permission/action identifiers are only in structured logs. Also split metrics: authz_policy_load_fail_total vs authz_policy_eval_error_total; deny reason label only for user-facing denials.

Allison Grant (review): Logging fields: can we align naming with our tracing/logging conventions? I’d prefer "authz.decision" and "authz.reason" rather than "authz_decision". Also please add request_id to the deny log line explicitly.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (author): Updated field names to dot-notation keys in the structured logger wrapper (we flatten to JSON keys), and added request_id + trace_id on deny logs.

Ethan Park (review): Concern: will always logging allow decisions blow up volume on hot endpoints? Even with debug level, some environments ship debug logs. Can we sample allows and only always-log denies?

Kaitlyn Nguyen (author): Addressed: allow decisions are sampled at 1% by default and gated behind AUTHZ_LOG_ALLOW_DECISIONS=true in prod. Denies always logged at warn. Added a unit test for sampler determinism.

Chloe Martin (review): For console backend, we should be able to display a nicer message for SCOPE_MISMATCH vs PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED. Please ensure reason codes are stable (don’t rename). Could you add a short enum doc comment?

Kaitlyn Nguyen (author): Added godoc on reason codes stating they’re stable contract for internal clients and future console UX. Also added a golden test asserting the set of reason codes.

Marcus Lin (follow-up): Please add a small note for SUPPORT_IMPERSONATION_DISABLED about not leaking whether support impersonation exists.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (author): Updated safe message to generic: "Action not permitted" while keeping reason code stable for internal correlation.

CI: Initial run failed lint due to unused import in tracing helper; fixed in follow-up commit. Re-run passed.

Approval: Marcus Lin approved. Ethan Park approved. Allison Grant approved with naming changes. Chloe Martin approved.

Merge: Squash merged by Kaitlyn Nguyen after CI green.
